Hi all — quick technical confirmations from infra/implementation perspective: 
- Dedicated: recommending Dedicated reserved pool for initial 90 days based on their expected 4k tokens/sec peak across user-facing flows. This gives predictable p50/p95 latency that matches their SLAs.
- Staging window: we can provision a staging cluster and a validation run starting 11/18; please provide list of test accounts and request a service account for ingestion.
- Telemetry: we will enable token-level metrics, error tagging, and an alerting webhook. I added a short capacity plan and quick runbook to the attachments (capacity_plan_v1.pdf).

Notes / risks:
- If they require HSM-backed key management for the first release, procurement lead time is ~3 weeks; flag now if this is a requirement.
- Model pinning: suggest we pin to open-model v1.4 quantized variant for first 30 days, then evaluate moving to the lower-latency experimental kernels once we have baseline metrics.

Next steps: Vivek to confirm final capacity numbers after we get historical throughput from NovoNexus (Eric/Sylvia) — target 11/14 EOD. Karthik, please share acceptance prompt set and target latency thresholds so we can bake them into the validation run.

Vivek Kulkarni
